function.name: analyze_repository
function.description: Deterministically analyze an application source repository and return the P0 structural context needed to begin a Kubernetes migration: components and service topology, images and Dockerfiles, build context/args, run command/entrypoint/worker count, container ports and exposed hosts, environment variables, Secret candidates, volumes and persistent data, health checks, service dependencies and startup order, DB migration/init tasks, whether the frontend API URL is build-time or runtime, Kubernetes workload drafts, and the operational inputs that CANNOT be decided from the repository. All facts are extracted by Python parsers with source-line evidence; no values are invented. Does NOT generate Kubernetes/Helm manifests.

repository_path.description: Filesystem path to the repository to analyze (read-only; never modified).

profile.description: Analysis profile. Only 'kubernetes-p0' is supported in this version.

build_system.description: Which build system to analyze when a repository ships more than one (e.g. both build.gradle and pom.xml). 'auto' selects deterministically and records the choice and how to switch.

git_ref.description: Optional commit SHA or ref to record in the result metadata for traceability. Purely informational; does not affect analysis.
